newsitem.title: UK: Thorntons Christmas sales up 10.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Thorntons Christmas sales up 10.6 pct.

text.p: British confectioner Thorntons Plc said on Wednesday its peak Christmas period sales from its own shops had risen by 10.6 percent on a like-for-like basis with overall growth in its first half a slightly firmer 13.2 percent.

In a statement the company said that in the seven-week period to December 28 the company's gross own-store sales rose by 25.7 percent, helped by the opening of new shops, and by 10.6 percent on a like-for-like basis.
